caption:
Osaka's 4 km street of Christmas lights is FREE ✨🎄

Midosuji Lights 2026 (御堂筋イルミネーション)
📅 3 Nov – 31 Dec 2026
🕔 Lights on from about 17:00 until 1:00 am
📍 Midosuji Avenue, from Umeda all the way to Namba, about 4 km
🎫 Free

Tip: walk a stretch, then hop on the Midosuji subway line, which runs right under the lights between Umeda and Namba 🚇

Save this for your Osaka December trip 📌
